app.name: Hubzy
app.tagline: Study by playing, breathe while learning

landing.hero_subtitle: Hubzy turns your documents into learning arenas with Hubzi, your capybara companion who also keeps you calm before exams.
landing.feature_1_desc: PDF, Word or photos of your summaries. AI extracts what matters.
landing.feature_2_desc: 20-level circuits, trap cards and battles that turn studying into a challenge.
landing.feature_3_desc: Breathing techniques and CBT-based emotional support when anxiety kicks in.
landing.disclaimer: Hubzy is not a mental health service. If you're in crisis, please seek professional help.

dashboard.subtitle: What are we studying today?
dashboard.empty_folders: You don't have folders yet. Create one and upload your notes to generate your first game.
dashboard.delete_account_desc: Deleting your account permanently removes your profile, folders, documents and progress data. This action cannot be undone.

zen.subtitle: Evidence-based emotional regulation techniques

crisis.title: You are not alone
crisis.body: We detected you might be going through a very difficult moment. Your wellbeing matters most. Please consider talking to someone right now.
crisis.continue: Understood, I want to continue calmly
